Prepared for The bakery owner Prepared by Jamie Reed Version 2.1 Date 2027-01-03 Status Final 1. Summary A small bread menu and pickup order tool. Customers can see what is available and book pickup before coming to the shop. 2. What you asked for and what you got NO. WHAT YOU ASKED FOR RESULT WHERE TO SEE IT M1 The customer can see today's bread and its price. DELIVERED The menu test found sourdough for AED 12.00 and rye for AED 10.00 in bakery.py. M2 The customer can order bread for pickup tomorrow or the day after. DELIVERED The order test in test_bakery.py printed a reference and date for both pickup days. M3 The bakery owner gets an email for every new order. CHANGED, APPROVED The order test found one saved notice per new order in messages.txt. M4 The customer can cancel an order before 18:00 the day before. DELIVERED The cancellation test in test_bakery.py removed the order at 17:59 and kept it at 18:00. M5 The bakery owner sees tomorrow's orders in one list. DELIVERED The list test in test_bakery.py showed earlier pickup dates first, grouped by date. W1 The menu and order both run on the bakery's computer. DELIVERED The fixture's menu and order tests ran on the bakery test computer. W2 A placed order shows its reference and pickup date. DELIVERED The order test compared each order's reference and pickup date. L1 The customer can use the menu and place an order with a keyboard. DELIVERED The menu and order tests used text commands alone. L2 Bread names and prices are readable without color. DELIVERED The menu test read the bread names and prices as plain text. H1 The bakery owner gets the source in bakery.py and the tests in test_bakery.py. DELIVERED The source is in bakery.py and the three tests in test_bakery.py passed. H2 README.md gives the commands to start the tool, place an order and open the list. DELIVERED README.md lists the commands to start the tool, place an order and open the list. 3. What changed since you approved it NO. POINT WHAT WAS BUILT DECISION C1 M3 Each new order writes a notice to messages.txt. KEEP 4. What was not built Out of scope NO. AGREED EXCLUSION RESULT WHERE TO SEE IT N1 It will not take payment online. LEFT OUT AS AGREED The order test carried out the pickup order without a payment step. Later Delivery. 5. Project dates 2026-11-30 Start 2026-12-10 Change request (+6 days) 2026-12-18 Planned end 2026-12-18 Delay (+9 days) 2027-01-02 Real end DATE WHAT HAPPENED ASKED BY DAYS WHY AND WHAT IT CHANGED 2026-12-10 Change request · Add pickup for the day after tomorrow. The bakery owner +6 The bakery owner asked to add a second pickup day. 2026-12-18 Delay · The oven supplier's price list arrived late. The oven supplier +9 The price list arrived 9 days late, moving the end by 9 days. 2026-12-18 +6 days +9 days = 2027-01-02 6. How it was tested See how each approved point was checked in the results above. The finished build also passed the project checks that applied to it. 7. What you receive The bakery owner gets the source in bakery.py and the tests in test_bakery.py. README.md gives the commands to start the tool, place an order and open the list. 8. What happens next The bakery owner receives it and signs the handover. The bakery owner tells customers at the counter. The bakery keeps the paper list for the first week. The bakery owner starts it from the terminal. The bakery owner tells the builder about faults. 9.
